title: Anthropic funding rounds
subtitle: Every round Anthropic announced itself, with the amount, the lead investors and the sentence quoted

rows.quote: Anthropic, an AI safety and research company, has raised $124 million in a Series A. | The Series A round was led by Jaan Tallinn, technology investor and co-founder of Skype.
Anthropic, an AI safety and research company, has raised $580 million in a Series B. | The Series B round was led by Sam Bankman-Fried, CEO of FTX.
we have raised $450 million in Series C funding led by Spark Capital with participation from Google, Salesforce Ventures, Sound Ventures, Zoom Ventures, and others.
Anthropic has raised $3.5 billion at a $61.5 billion post-money valuation. The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners

rows.led_by: ICONIQ; co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company, Lightspeed Venture Partners
rows.quote: Anthropic has completed a Series F fundraising of $13 billion led by ICONIQ. This financing values Anthropic at $183 billion post-money. Along with ICONIQ, the round was co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company and Lightspeed Venture Partners.

rows.led_by: GIC, Coatue; co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, MGX
rows.quote: We have raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue, valuing Anthropic at $380 billion post-money. The round was co-led by D. E. Shaw Ventures, Dragoneer, Founders Fund, ICONIQ, and MGX. | This round also includes a portion of the previously announced investments from Microsoft and NVIDIA.

rows.led_by: Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, Sequoia Capital; co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, XN
rows.quote: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money. | The round was co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, and XN. | It also includes $15 billion of previously committed investments from hyperscalers, including $5 billion from Amazon .

takeaway: Anthropic announced 7 funding rounds from 2021 to 2026, $112.7B in all; the latest is Series H on 2026-05-28: $65B at $965B post-money.
assumptions: Only rounds Anthropic announced on anthropic.com/news. Series A to C announcements state no valuation, so those cells are blank, not zero.

Series D (reported by the press as led by Menlo Ventures) was never announced by Anthropic. The press pages found say only that it was 'in talks' (CNBC, 2023-12-21) or give a rounded $18 billion with no close date (TechCrunch, 2026-06-23), so it is left out until a dated, citable source is found.

Series G includes a portion of the Microsoft and NVIDIA investments announced in November 2025; Series H includes $15 billion previously committed by hyperscalers, of which $5 billion from Amazon. Amounts are as Anthropic states them.
Anthropic confidentially submitted a draft S-1 on 2026-06-01 (anthropic.com/news/confidential-draft-s1-sec). No S-1 is public on EDGAR yet.
